new.analysis:
## What the week showed

Nothing was recorded between Mon Sep 21 and Sun Sep 27, so all three planned walk-runs were missed. That is useful information, not a failure, but it does mean we do not add volume on top of a week off.

## Why this plan

I am repeating the week of Sep 14 – 20 almost exactly, because you ran all three of those sessions with heart rate in a sensible range, pain 0/10, and felt 6 – 7 out of 10. Climbing from zero back to 24, 24 and 27 minutes of walk-run is already a real week; stacking more on would raise the risk of another gap.

## Looking ahead

From the week of Oct 5 onward we grow the run intervals: 3 minutes running with 1 minute walking, then 4 and 1, so by race week you can hold a steady jog for 30 minutes. If this week lands cleanly, that progression stays on track for Nov 15.

## One ask

In the next check-in, a line on what pulled you away last week helps me plan around it. If anything felt off physically, say so and we adjust rather than guess.
